The Global Operations Coordinator coordinates UC Davis staff internationally hired program staff, and multiple partner organizations to deliver effective transdisciplinary and multi-national project management. Specifically, this position supports programmatic activities related to international clinical trial assessments of medical countermeasures and disease biosurveillance studies. Generally, this position supports collaborative partnerships, implements strategic direction (including scientific and technical guidance), assures compliance and oversight of operations, facilitates achievement of objectives and accomplishment of deliverables, and directs mandatory and ad hoc reporting required by funders. Responsible for many aspects of project and contract/grant acquisition, administration, implementation, and reporting, including development of project tracking mechanisms, project oversight, global outcomes and impacts, international communications of accomplishments to many organizations. International development professional with a good degree of knowledge in the overall technical field, as well as business process improvement, with the skills to perform complex technical and financial and project analyses.
60% - Program Implementation
30% - Award Compliance and Proposal Work
10% - University Services
